title: Pardons Joseph M. Arpaio
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Joseph M. Arpaio as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: On August 25, 2017, President Donald Trump pardoned Joseph M. Arpaio. The Justice Department’s clemency list identifies his federal case in the District of Arizona and gives the offense as contempt of court; the list records no sentence. The supplied material does not describe the court order or the events behind the contempt finding.
organization_tags: U.S. District Court for the District of Arizona

title: Pardons Topeka Kimberly Sam
description_short: Trump granted a presidential pardon to Topeka Kimberly Sam as part of a clemency list.
description_medium: The Justice Department’s pardon list identifies Topeka Kimberly Sam as a recipient in an Eastern District of Virginia case. It records a 52-month prison sentence, later amended by court orders, followed by five years of supervised release. The listed offense was conspiracy to possess cocaine hydrochloride with intent to distribute.
